set.body:
Outcome
Apply the system consistently outside the main scene graph.

Owned scope
theme overlay recipes; workbench overlay binding; popup/dialog fixtures

Prerequisites
B3

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Cover context/menu/menu-button controls, combo/choice/date/color popups, tooltips, alerts and dialogs in main and floating owners.
- [ ] Check appearance changes while overlays are open and creation after a switch; no stale palette, density or fallback Modena/Atlanta default remains unintentionally visible.
- [ ] Popup location and clipping remain correct near window/display edges and enlarged text; overlays stay usable at 800×600.
- [ ] Escape, selection/activation and focus return respect the original owner; a closed owner does not retain an overlay or focus target.
- [ ] Use platform-native file dialogs where applicable and document that OS-controlled surfaces are outside CSS styling.

Required evidence
Native open-overlay captures and owner/focus/close-lifecycle assertions in all four variants.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code C3. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [C3] Complete menus, popups, dialogs and overlay lifecycle
